concurrency_justification.rationale: one-writer append-only capture/control tables; WAL allows concurrent readers during writes; measured 262 MB live DB with 1.49M snapshots operates fine today
concurrency_justification.research_snapshots: immutable partitioned Parquet read by pandas/PyArrow — no JSON-blob probability vectors

scale_measurements.decision: Do not introduce a new service/database until measured concurrency requires it (issue contract).

principle: AGENTS.md principle 1 — no backward-compat tax. Obsolete ambiguous schemas are removed from the accepted interface, not wrapped in compatibility layers.
